description.zh: 救世基督像矗立于里约热内卢科科瓦多山顶，高38米（含底座），双臂展开28米，俯瞰整个城市和瓜纳巴拉湾。1931年落成，是世界新七大奇迹之一。
description.en: Christ the Redeemer stands 38 m tall (including base) atop Corcovado mountain, arms outstretched 28 m, gazing over Rio and Guanabara Bay. Completed in 1931 and one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.

location.zh: 里约热内卢科科瓦多山

description.zh: 亚马逊是世界上最大的热带雨林，覆盖面积超过550万平方公里，是地球上超过10%物种的家园。从玛瑙斯出发可进行深度雨林探险，体验原始的热带生态系统。
description.en: The Amazon is the world's largest tropical rainforest, covering over 5.5 million km2 and home to more than 10% of all Earth's species. Manaus is the gateway for deep-jungle expeditions.

description.zh: 伊瓜苏瀑布横跨巴西和阿根廷边境，是世界上最宽的瀑布群，由275条瀑布组成，宽约2,700米。巴西侧可欣赏到全景，阿根廷侧则可近距离感受「魔鬼咽喉」的震撼。
description.en: Iguazu Falls straddles the Brazil-Argentina border — the world's widest waterfall system, with 275 falls stretching 2,700 m. Brazil's side gives the panoramic view; Argentina's side puts you inside the Devil's Throat.

description.zh: 里约狂欢节是全球最盛大的狂欢节，每年吸引超过200万人参与街头庆典。桑巴舞校在桑巴大道的巡游是其核心活动，华丽的服装、激昂的音乐和热情的舞蹈令全世界为之倾倒。
description.en: Rio Carnival is the world's largest, drawing over 2 million street revellers. The centrepiece is the samba school parade on the Sambadrome, a riot of elaborate costumes, thunderous drums and passionate dance.
